source.title: Precast Bridge Beams
source.pages: 18 A4 pages; PDF page = printed page for pp. 6-15
source.property_table_note: Each family page prints depth, area, Yb, Zt, Zb and approximate self-weight (edge beams TYE/YE also Yc from the vertical face). Published I is taken as Zb*Yb (Zt*(d-Yb) is checked as a second estimate).

units: mm (source units mm; section moduli 1e6 mm3; self-weight kN/m)

ty_type1.title: TY Type 1 Beam Range (beam and slab)
ty_type1.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)

transcribed_dims_mm.construction_point: web-line x flange-line intersection 164 wide at 268

geometry_notes: Web line through (92.5, 320) and half-width 200 at y = 850 (printed 400 over 530 rise); it also passes the printed 164-wide construction point at y = 268 (163.9).

Cap uses the printed per-size width (176...298) with vertical sides 50 high; the horizontal ledge at d-50 runs from the cap to the web line, so the ledge is 40.7-41.5 mm, not exactly the printed nominal 40 (printed cap widths are rounded down ~1.6-2.4 mm relative to web(d-50) - 80).
Printed '10' and '5' vertical dims near the web/shoulder junction locate dashed construction lines only; not modelled.

tolerances.justification: printed cap widths are rounded (<=2.4 mm): area 0.05%

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: Same lower profile, web line and 50-high ledge. Only the cap width differs: FP prints rounded caps (176..298) vs Banagher Wf (178.0..299.7), i.e. <=1.2 mm per side (<=130 mm2). FP's own table differs from Banagher's by ~-160 mm2 in every size.

ty_type2.title: TY Type 2 Beam Range (solid infill)
ty_type2.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: No ledge: the web line runs to the top; top width = web-line width at y = d. Printed top widths (217...400) agree with the web line to within 0.5 mm (rounding).

tolerances.justification: exact printed geometry; I via 4-s.f. moduli

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: Same outline to rounding (symmetric difference <=10 mm2, from Banagher's 1-dp Wf); FP and Banagher Type 2 / solid-slab property tables are identical.

tye.title: TYE Beam Range (edge beam, beam and slab)
tye.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: Vertical face at x = +375 as drawn (FP draws the face on the right; Banagher/ie on the left). Bottom corner at the face has the 25 x 25 chamfer.
Web line and ledge as TY Type 1; cap edge at x = 375 - printed face-to-cap distance.

I_zt_rel.reason: printed Zt 28.87 inconsistent with its own Zb*Yb (Zt*(d-Yb) gives I 7% high; Banagher prints the same row) - source misprint

I_zb_rel.reason: printed Zb 48.17 inconsistent with Zt*(d-Yb) (I 4% high; implied Zb ~46.2) - source misprint

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: Mirror image (FP face at +x, Banagher at -x); cap widths differ only by FP's rounding (<=1 mm); property tables identical.

y.title: Y Beam Range
y.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)

transcribed_dims_mm.ledge_detail: cap 50 high, ledge 40 wide, 5 x 5 chamfer at the ledge outer corner

geometry_notes: Printed web width 200 read as the web width at y = 379 (flange-slope / web-line intersection, 202 + 177); a web line from (100, 379) to (cap/2 + 40, d - 55) reproduces it (extrapolating the caps gives 199.8).
Fillet taken at the printed minimum radius 100 mm, tangent to the flange slope and web line; its web tangent point is 218 mm wide (printed '216 minimum').
Ledge: web line ends at d-55, 45-degree 5 mm chamfer to d-50, horizontal to the printed cap, cap vertical 50 to the top.

tolerances.justification: Yb printed to the integer (+-0.5 mm) and fillet radius taken at the printed minimum; residual area +0.08..+0.16% remains (not closed by any printed dimension)

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: ie Y is a least-squares fitted reconstruction (no fillet, straight splay to a fitted waist, no chamfers or ledge); FP prints the outline (25 chamfers, 202 flange side, 177 splay, 200 web at 379, R100 fillet, 40x50 ledge). Up to ~65 mm apart; FP table also differs slightly from Banagher's (e.g. Y1 309202 vs 310140 mm2).

ye.title: YE Beam Range (edge beam)
ye.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)

transcribed_dims_mm.web_side: 'See Y beam details for dimensions of this side'
transcribed_dims_mm.rebate: 40 wide at the face ('rebate omitted if not required on edge detail'); height not printed

geometry_notes: Right (web) side identical to the Y beam right side (as the page instructs).

Rebate at the face: 40 wide (printed) x 50 deep (not printed; taken equal to the Y ledge height). With the rebate the published areas are met to <=0.07%; without it the residual is +0.3-0.5%, so the tabulated properties include the rebate.
Printed rebate-to-cap distances (434...535) = Y cap half-width + 335, i.e. the same web/cap as the Y beam.

yc_abs.reason: Yc printed as an integer (298); computed 298.60 is 0.1 mm beyond rounding and depends on the unprinted rebate height (50 assumed)

tolerances.justification: Yb and Yc printed to the integer

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: ie YE is a fitted reconstruction; FP prints the Y-side details, 40-wide rebate and cap offsets. Up to ~52 mm apart.

my.title: MY Beam Range (solid slab)
my.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: Top width is not printed: 440 at y >= 500 is an estimate (drawing scales 437) and reproduces all seven areas; web flares linearly from 300 at y = 150 to 440 at y = 500; MY1-MY5 tops lie on the flare.
Bevel from the flange top at y = 125 to the web base at y = 150: rise 25 printed, run 15 fitted to the published areas (drawing scales ~20; run 20 gives +0.1% area).
Flange top slopes straight from (485, 100) to (165, 125).

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: ie MY is fitted (6.7 chamfer, waist at 124); FP prints 25 chamfers, 75 edge, 125/150 bevel, 300 web and a vertical top above 500. Up to ~18 mm apart; property tables identical.

sy.title: SY Beam Range
sy.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: Web line from (100, 429) (printed 200 at y = 252 + 177 = 429) to half-width 160 at y = 1450 (printed 1021 rise; 320 width), vertical 320 above 1450 up to d - 50; fillet at the printed minimum radius 100.

Top notch: the label reads '50 x 50' but a 50-wide notch (cap 220) leaves the area 0.2% and I 0.6% below the table; a 40-wide x 50-high ledge (cap 240, as on the Y/TY pages) reproduces area to 0.03% and I to 0.02%. Implemented cap 240 (convention); the '50 x 50' label is recorded as a conflict.
SY6 printed Yb 865.36 breaks the ~51.3 mm/100 mm progression (expected ~855.5, and Zt/Zb imply ~855): pinned as a source misprint.

yb_abs.reason: printed Yb 865.36 breaks the progression (expected ~855.5; geometry 855.48) - source misprint

I_zb_rel.reason: follows from the SY6 Yb misprint

I_zt_rel.reason: follows from the SY6 Yb misprint

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: Same 240 cap/40x50 ledge and stem top (160 at 1450); lower splay differs: FP 252 flange side + 177 splay + R100 fillet vs ie fitted splay (397/487). Up to ~10.5 mm apart; FP table differs from Banagher's by ~-930 mm2.

w.title: W Beams Range (open trough)
w.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: Outer face from (755, 25) to (L1/2, d - 50); bottom 1510 at the chamfer tops, 25 x 25 chamfers.
Notch height: the vertical chain 75 + F + S + Web + 150 + 210 exceeds the depth by 25 for every size; notch height 50 closes the chain and is used (printed '75' recorded as a conflict).
Notch width 60 as printed: L1/2 - 60 - L2 - 60 = L3/2 for W1, W5, W7, W8, W9. W3 printed L3 = 1058 is a misprint (dims close at 1086); L3 is derived, not read from the table.

Inner web parallel to the outer face (82 deg) at 170 horizontal thickness; lower inner kink 275 horizontally inside the outer face at y = 210, upper inner kink at y = 360 on the inner web; upper web kink at y = d - 50 - F - S on the inner web. The printed '138' offset (inner face to upper kink) does not close with 170/82 deg (gives ~116) and is not used.

With the printed 60-wide notches the areas are 0.8% and I 1.6-2.4% below the table in every size: pinned. The published W table is numerically identical to Banagher's, whose 40-wide notch (cap = L2 + 40) closes these residuals, so FP's drawing and table are not mutually consistent.

area_rel.reason: FP drawing's 60-wide top notches (L1/L2/L3 close only with 60) vs table identical to Banagher's (which closes with 40-wide notches)

banagher_ie_comparison.differences: FP top notches 60 wide (ie 40), FP bottom 1510 at 25 chamfers (ie 1500 at 20 chamfers), FP lower inner kinks from the 275/170 dims (ie from 2006 CAD: (500,210),(625,360)). Up to 20 mm apart; FP property table identical to Banagher's for these six sizes.

box.title: Box Beams Range (solid)
box.source_status: producer catalogue (FP McCann Precast Bridge Beams v1.0, 2025)
geometry_notes: Solid sections: no voids are drawn or implied (published areas equal the solid outline to the mm2).
Only SD1-SD6 (300-800) are tabulated although the elevation sketch labels beams up to 1000.

yb_abs.reason: computed Yb 393.497 sits on the rounding boundary; printed 394 (0.003 mm beyond the +-0.5 integer rounding)

tolerances.justification: Yb printed to the integer (I via Zb*Yb carries up to 0.35% rounding)
